primary_purpose: Replicate the fixed 0.5 SHAM-LOW intervention on fresh worlds and report recurrence of the unchanged Q same-seed predicates and the full per-seed response matrix.

q_labels_unchanged.material_continuous_gain: step-120 mean SHAM-LOW minus SHAM delta_p_new >= +0.020
q_labels_unchanged.direction: SHAM-LOW correct-direction rate >= 0.99 and no more than 0.01 below concurrent SHAM
q_labels_unchanged.preservation: SHAM-LOW A_old >= concurrent SHAM - 0.05 overall and >= concurrent SHAM - 0.10 in every family
q_labels_unchanged.q_operating_point_seed_pass: same-seed conjunction of gain, direction, material locality advantage over DUP, and preservation
q_labels_unchanged.q_operating_point_cohort: at least two thirds of R1 paired seeds pass the same-seed conjunction; for 12 seeds this is at least 8
q_labels_unchanged.q_stiff_coupling_seed: same seed has material gain; each SHAM-LOW L1 differs from concurrent DUP by <=10% relative to DUP; both MAP-flip differences are <=0.05 absolute
q_labels_unchanged.q_stiff_coupling_cohort: at least two thirds of R1 paired seeds pass the same-seed conjunction; for 12 seeds this is at least 8
q_labels_unchanged.q_map_response_seed: both F_new and Strict improve by >=0.10 versus concurrent SHAM in the same seed
q_labels_unchanged.q_map_response_cohort: at least two thirds of R1 paired seeds pass; for 12 seeds this is at least 8
q_labels_unchanged.seed_population_interpretation: report counts out of 12 as observed recurrence; no universal population law or pooled-seed inferential p-value

original_q_coordinates: signed mean new_probability_delta and neighborhood distribution
sham L1 and sham MAP-flip rate
matched-neutral L1 and matched-neutral MAP-flip rate

multiclass_geometry.strongest_competitor_identity: semantic candidate ID attaining the max over c != intended winner; ties use earliest index in frozen candidate order
multiclass_geometry.anchor_frozen_argmax_candidate_id: candidate ID selected by the existing frozen argmax tie convention on P_A
multiclass_geometry.fact_frozen_argmax_candidate_id: candidate ID selected by the existing frozen argmax tie convention on P_F
multiclass_geometry.gap_sign_interpretation: positive means unique intended winner; negative means intended candidate loses; zero is a tie and actual winner is determined only by the frozen argmax candidate ID

required_per_seed_arm_checkpoint_metrics.family_reporting: all original and added metrics by the four fixed families at every contracted checkpoint

secondary_step80_to120_landmark_analysis.purpose: Describe whether the step-80 landmark state, after substantial exposure to the same arm, is associated with step-120 outcomes; not a pre-treatment adjustment, causal mediation, or evidence that initial state predicts intervention response
step80_state: fact_new_winner_gap = P_F(new_id) - max(P_F(c) for c != new_id)
anchor_old_winner_gap = P_A(old_id) - max(P_A(c) for c != old_id)
actual frozen argmax candidate IDs and strongest competitors for anchor and fact views
descriptive_methods: per-seed × arm × family joint tables of step-80 state and step-120 outcomes
Spearman rank association computed as Pearson correlation of average ranks; constant input yields null; report coefficient only, no across-seed p-value

for each of the seven continuous step-80 variables (two pairwise margins, two multiclass gaps, new-candidate probability movement, sham L1, matched L1), form quartiles separately within seed × arm × family; sort only by that step-80 variable then canonical neighborhood_id, split into four equal groups of 125, and report step-120 outcome rates
A_old and F_new are binary step-80 strata for cross-tabulation only; do not create quartiles from binary variables
quartile membership is never derived from step-120 outcomes

initialization_baseline.purpose: descriptive pre-treatment context using the 12 already-budgeted shared initialization states
initialization_baseline.report: for each seed, report the initialization geometry and response coordinates alongside, but separately from, the four arm-specific step-120 outcomes
initialization_baseline.interpretation: descriptive association only; no causal or population claim

resampling.interval: paired neighborhood 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles conditional on each seed and the fixed R1 panel
resampling.paired_interval_excludes_zero: annotation only; not an added gate

reporting.respiratory_crossing_and_vibration_prese: predeclared secondary descriptive replication question; failure to repeat does not invalidate broader heterogeneity report
reporting.descriptive_patterns: may be cross-tabulated from the unchanged Q seed predicates; do not promote post-hoc phenotype names to new gates
